objective: Implement video pause immediately at scroll start, partial-frame autoplay, bounded nearby video warming, original-quality scrollback cache and policy-safe next NativeAd prefetch in Android BUKLOD DEV only.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: November 14 2026 main commit 7ebbbd504df2f84355888cc64a8c5317319d6d65 published Android production runtime 1.3.2 OTA update 01a1da5c-0179-79fc-85c9-591cdb782190 in completed-success run 43602250206. This isolated DEV PR has NOT shipped to staging or production; no physical device claim.
chosenApproach: One shared 180ms idle scroll-pause signal, real video frame geometry gating in Wall and Scope, single next clip/Marites prewarm, bounded NativeAd SDK asset prefetch without offscreen NativeAdView or premature impressions; preserve unchanged banner unit IDs, consent, IMA and network request pacing. Run focused feature contracts; no production release.
selectionRationale: Narrowly addresses owner-visible delayed playback and scrolling resource use without replacing the approved Android video player, degrading resolution or adding expensive native/build dependencies. Native AdMob assets are cached briefly before a future eligible placement rather than requesting invisible banner impressions.
alternativeApproaches: Rendering offscreen BannerAd or hidden NativeAdView (rejected as unsafe impression/fill behavior).
Rebuild Android APK for JS-only scroll behavior (unnecessary while runtime compatibility not independently established).
Unconditional autoplay for any row containing a video (rejected because the video frame may be offscreen).
preserveBehaviors: Original-quality content video sources and existing cached decoder, Android Expo Video/IMA source, sound focus, signed URL recovery and retry remain unchanged.
Inactive and offscreen media do not autoplay; scrolling instantly pauses before exiting viewport, resumes after 180ms idle only if actual frame is visible.
Retired IGPAT feature stays hidden; existing historical posts and independent Wall/Marites media are preserved.
AdMob consent, production unit IDs, native and banner distinct lifecycles, request throttling and SDK-only impressions remain unchanged.
NativeAdView is not created while out of viewport, despite one eligible next NativeAd being loaded by SDK.
Home, Cluster, Wall, Connect and Profile routes, QMP/Finance, PTT/Call and owner privacy/RLS preserved.
No production, staging OTA, Android binary, Play, web, Supabase migration or Finance mutation in this scope.
acceptanceChecks: Actual media-frame viewport intersection, not entire post, determines Wall/Scope player activation.
One moving feed event pauses video even if still visible; no resumption until scrolling idle 180ms and eligible.
One near-viewport video warms before entry with unmodified original quality and existing cached player after scrolling back.
Marites prepared player remains paused until partial visibility and scroll stops; only one active story clip.
SDK native ad assets preload one nearby slot before its appearance; no offscreen NativeAdView, early impression or banner prefetch; respect consent and request pacing.
Scoped release manifest and feature-specific tests pass protected feature lock; Android TypeScript bundle/Expo parity must pass before any staging OTA.
Compile actual Android staging-identity JS bundle on exact DEV candidate head without uploading or publishing any OTA.
